gbdt.feature_definition: X1 posterior temporal features + 128-dimensional Short hidden state + causal MFCC current/trailing mean/delta (X3, 330 features)

nemo_marblenet.mapping: last completed 20 ms output at each 10 ms grid frame

silero.mapping: last completed 512-sample window at each 10 ms grid frame

webrtc.mapping: one 10 ms frame per MFCC grid frame

mechanism.different_source_donor: train-split video with closest overall speech fraction; donor frame matched to target binary label
mechanism.remote_definition: lags > d, i.e. older than distance d

metrics.hard_frame_definition: top fraction of frames by smallest abs(P_short - 0.5), selected separately within each test video
